nodes.label: W-243 — the four sites repaired to the same bound
nodes.rationale: Batch A item 3; M: 'this is obviously yes, and did not require a ruling from me' — the question should not have been asked, because ruling 12 states a rule and not only a site.

nodes.label: Register 1838
nodes.rationale: Both bundles moved in one build because a volume may not change unless a Register entry in the same build records it, and the sites and the entry live in different bundles.

nodes.label: Census id 1610 retired — a GONE row is a ruling
nodes.rationale: close_census2.py refuses to drop a seated id and requires --retire to be typed, because an id is an address every CENSUS-CLOSURES file may cite; the row is carried verbatim with 'RETIRED W-243: not measured at this build' so it still resolves.

nodes.label: A hand-written row in the ≥ 7 citation table
nodes.rationale: Register 1704 crossed to seven citations; the tool refuses to invent a row, so it was written by hand from 1704's own headline — which states the superseded bound. That is the append-only Register working as designed: both states preserved.

nodes.label: r4-a3.py — both bundles in one build
nodes.rationale: BUILD112 → BUILD113 main and BUILD235 → BUILD236 compendia, each reverse-guarded to its own predecessor md5; each substitution asserted unique in its own member rather than in the bundle, because WORKING-REGISTER.md quotes one of the sentences verbatim and the audit log is never edited.
